newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE trades busiest ever month in October.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE trades busiest ever month in October.

text.p: The London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange (LIFFE) said on Monday that 18.4 million contracts were traded last month, the exchange's highest ever monthly volume.
The figure represented a 68 percent leap from October 1995's volume and replaced the previous monthly record set in February this year, LIFFE said in a statement.
For the year to date, LIFFE volumes were 140.97 million contracts, up 24 percent on the same period last year, it said.
LIFFE's chairman Jack Wigglesworth said the data underscored LIFFE's continuing ability to offer a deep, liquid market.

He said volumes had broken through to new highs because of ever-increasing interest in European Economic and Monetary Union and volatility surrounding a 25 basis point interest rate rise in Britain last week.
Individual records were set in Euromark futures, which reached a new daily volume high, and Eurolira, Euroswiss and short sterling futures, which each set new monthly peaks.
Options on Italian BTP futures set a new daily record of 54,852 contract on October 3, while FTSE index options set a new monthly record of 397,119 contracts traded, LIFFE said.
